title_en: Beijing Haidian District People's Procuratorate v. Wu Jinyan — intentional injury case
keywords_en: Criminal; intentional injury; first instance; basic people's court; Beijing; natural person; Criminal Law; General Principles of Civil Law; recognition of self-defense; whether defense conduct exceeds necessary limits; exemption from criminal liability; assumption of civil compensation liability; dismissal of claims; illegal intrusion; violent injury; defense conduct; causing death; self-defense
full_text_en:
Beijing Haidian District People's Procuratorate v. Wu Jinyan — intentional injury case

[Ruling Summary]

Pursuant to the provisions of Article 20(3) of the Criminal Law and Article 128 of the General Principles of the Civil Law, a citizen who, in defense against a person who illegally breaks into their residence late at night and violently assaults them or others, causes the death of the unlawful infringer, shall not bear criminal liability or civil compensation liability.

Prosecutorial Authority: Beijing Haidian District People's Procuratorate.

Plaintiff in the Incidental Civil Action: Li Quanyou, male, 45 years old, Beijing resident, residing in Haidian District, Beijing.

Plaintiff in the Incidental Civil Action: Zhang Dehua, female, 45 years old, Beijing resident, residing in Haidian District, Beijing.

Defendant: Wu Jinyan, female, 21 years old, a native of Ar Horqin Banner, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, a waitress at Yangtai Mountain Villa Restaurant in Haidian District, Beijing. Arrested on October 15, 2003.

The Beijing Haidian District People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution against the defendant Wu Jinyan for intentional injury before the Beijing Haidian District People's Court, and the plaintiffs in the incidental civil action, Li Quanyou and Zhang Dehua, simultaneously filed an incidental civil action.

The indictment alleged: At approximately 3:00 a.m. on September 10, 2003, the victim Li Guanghui (male, 19 years old), together with Sun Jingang (male, 22 years old) and Zhang Jinqiang (male, 21 years old), went to the female staff dormitory of Yangtai Mountain Villa Restaurant (hereinafter referred to as the "Restaurant") in Haidian District, Beijing, and called out for waitress Yin Xiaohong (female, 24 years old) to come out and resolve a personal dispute. Upon seeing that Yin Xiaohong ignored them, Sun Jingang and others forcibly entered the dormitory. Sun Jingang engaged in a quarrel with Yin Xiaohong and beat her. The defendant Wu Jinyan, who was also residing in the dormitory, stepped forward to intervene, and Sun Jingang then engaged in a physical struggle with Wu Jinyan. During the struggle, Sun Jingang tore off the buttons of Wu Jinyan's blouse, and Wu Jinyan, holding a fruit knife, cut Sun Jingang's left upper arm. Upon seeing this, Li Guanghui attempted to strike Wu Jinyan with an iron padlock, at which point Wu Jinyan stabbed Li Guanghui in the left chest with the fruit knife, causing a 2.7 cm stab wound to the left chest, resulting in death due to acute hemorrhagic shock. On the same day, Wu Jinyan was apprehended by public security authorities, and the instrument used was also recovered. Wu Jinyan, disregarding the law, intentionally injured the health of a citizen over a trivial matter, causing death. Her conduct violated Article 234(2) of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Criminal Law") and constituted the crime of intentional injury, for which she should be punished according to law.

The plaintiffs in the incidental civil action, Li Quanyou and Zhang Dehua, requested that the defendant Wu Jinyan be ordered to compensate them for Li Guanghui's death damages, funeral expenses, and support expenses, totaling RMB 181,080, and submitted to the court materials including funeral expense receipts and calculations for support expenses.

The defendant Wu Jinyan argued: Sun Jingang beat, humiliated, and attempted to rape Yin Xiaohong. When I approached to stop him, Sun Jingang then beat and humiliated me, tearing open my blouse and exposing my upper body, which made me feel greatly humiliated. I believed Sun Jingang was about to rape me, so I picked up the knife in self-defense. At that moment, Li Guanghui came at me with an iron padlock, so I stabbed Li Guanghui. If Sun Jingang and Li Guanghui had not assaulted Yin Xiaohong and me, I would not have stabbed them. Li Guanghui brought this upon himself and should bear the losses himself. Wu Jinyan's defense counsel argued that, pursuant to Article 20(3) of the Criminal Law, Wu Jinyan's conduct constituted justifiable defense, did not exceed the necessary limit, did not constitute a crime, and she should not bear civil liability.

In response to the defendant's arguments and the defense counsel's opinions, the prosecutor replied as follows: Although the victim Li Guanghui entered the female staff dormitory together with Sun Jingang, he did not commit any harmful acts against Yin Xiaohong or Wu Jinyan. Li Guanghui's act of picking up the padlock to strike Wu Jinyan was intended to stop the struggle between Sun Jingang and Wu Jinyan. Although Wu Jinyan was subjected to an attack by Sun Jingang, she had multiple options for seeking help at the time. Moreover, the conduct of Li Guanghui and others did not reach a level that seriously endangered the personal safety of Wu Jinyan and others, and no harmful consequences resulted. Therefore, Wu Jinyan's stabbing of Li Guanghui did not constitute justifiable defense. Considering that the victim's side also engaged in unlawful conduct and bore significant fault, and Wu Jinyan demonstrated a good attitude of admitting guilt, a lenient punishment could be imposed at the court's discretion. The plaintiffs in the incidental civil action, Li Quanyou and Zhang Dehua, demanded severe punishment for Wu Jinyan.

The Beijing Haidian District People's Court found through trial:

Sun Jingang and Li Guanghui, farmers from Bei'anhe Village, Haidian District, Beijing, had previously been employees of the restaurant. Sun Jingang left the restaurant in August 2003, and Li Guanghui was dismissed from the restaurant on September 9, 2003. At approximately 8:00 p.m. on September 9, 2003, Li Guanghui and Zhang Jinqiang (also a farmer from Bei'anhe Village, Haidian District) called Sun Jingang to Zhang Jinqiang's home and told him that Yin Xiaohong had reported to the restaurant manager that the three of them had eaten, taken cigarettes, and used the sauna at the restaurant without paying, which led to Li Guanghui's dismissal. They also said that Sun Jingang had been pursuing a romantic relationship with Yin Xiaohong, but not only did Yin Xiaohong refuse, she also insulted Sun Jingang, calling him foolish. Sun Jingang became very angry upon hearing this and threatened Yin Xiaohong over the phone, vowing to "leave a mark" on her. The three immediately conspired to forcibly take Yin Xiaohong to a hotel at the foot of the mountain and detain her for two days. At approximately 11:00 p.m. that night, the three, after drinking, went up the mountain to the restaurant and knocked on the main door. When they were prevented from entering by a guest, they waited outside the restaurant. At approximately 2:00 a.m. the next morning, Sun Jingang, seeing that there were no guests in the restaurant and that Yin Xiaohong and other waitresses had gone to sleep, kicked open the wooden door of the small courtyard leading to the female staff dormitory and knocked on the dormitory door, calling for Yin Xiaohong to come out, but Yin Xiaohong refused. At approximately 3:00 a.m., Sun Jingang, Li Guanghui, and Zhang Jinqiang again came to the female staff dormitory and continued to demand that Yin Xiaohong open the door. When she again refused, they forcibly broke down the door and entered. Sun Jingang walked directly to Yin Xiaohong's bedside, Li Guanghui stood beside the bed of the defendant Wu Jinyan, who was also residing in the same dormitory, and Zhang Jinqiang stood at the dormitory door. After entering, Sun Jingang pulled back Yin Xiaohong's blanket and attempted to forcibly take her down the mountain. When she refused, he beat Yin Xiaohong and tore her pajamas, exposing her chest. Upon seeing this, Wu Jinyan got out of bed to intervene. Sun Jingang turned and beat Wu Jinyan, tearing open her pajamas with one pull, exposing her chest, and then kicked and beat Wu Jinyan. Wu Jinyan, reaching out, grabbed a fruit knife with a blade length of 14.5 cm and a width of 2 cm from the bedside table and cut Sun Jingang's left upper arm. Li Guanghui picked up an iron padlock, 11 cm long, 6.5 cm wide, and weighing 550 grams, from the table, intending to strike Wu Jinyan. Wu Jinyan then stabbed Li Guanghui with the knife, and Li Guanghui immediately collapsed. Upon seeing Li Guanghui collapse, Wu Jinyan was momentarily shocked, then ran out of the dormitory to call the restaurant manager. Public security authorities apprehended Wu Jinyan at the scene at approximately 4:30 a.m. on the same day. Forensic examination determined that Li Guanghui had a 2.7 cm stab wound to the left chest and died of acute hemorrhagic shock.

The above facts were confirmed by the following evidence submitted by the prosecutorial authority:

1. Testimony of witness Sun Jingang, mainly stating: At approximately 8:00 p.m. on September 9, 2003, he was called to Zhang Jinqiang's home, where he heard Zhang Jinqiang and Li Guanghui say, "Yin Xiaohong, a waitress at Yangtai Mountain Villa, said you are foolish. You often buy her things, but she doesn't appreciate it." He became very angry and called Yin Xiaohong to confront her. That night, after drinking, the three discussed forcibly taking Yin Xiaohong to a hotel at the foot of the mountain and detaining her for two days; he planned to "leave a mark" on Yin Xiaohong. At about 11:30 p.m., the three went to the restaurant but did not dare to enter because there were guests. Later, seeing Yin Xiaohong and others return to the dormitory to sleep, they knocked on the small wooden door of the dormitory courtyard three times, calling for Yin Xiaohong, but no one opened the door. He then kicked open the small wooden door, and the three knocked on the female staff dormitory door twice more, calling for Yin Xiaohong to come out. After being refused, at approximately 3:00 a.m., they again came to the dormitory, reached through the broken glass on the right side of the door to pull the latch, and entered. He walked directly to Yin Xiaohong's bed, pulled back her blanket, and engaged in a physical fight with her. When Wu Jinyan saw him beating Yin Xiaohong, she got up and came to Yin Xiaohong's bed to stop him, and they began to grapple. He seemed to have torn Wu Jinyan's clothes. Then he saw Wu Jinyan produce a fruit knife; he backed away, lifting his leg to block, and retreated to the foot of the bed. Li Guanghui was standing at the foot of the bed and helped him block Wu Jinyan. As he retreated, he saw Li Guanghui leaning against the cabinet at the foot of the bed, clutching his chest, and then collapse. He did not see Wu Jinyan stab Li Guanghui, nor did he know how he himself was injured.

2. Testimony of witness Zhang Jinqiang, mainly stating: He, Li Guanghui, and Sun Jingang had previously eaten, used the sauna, and taken cigarettes at the restaurant without paying, which led to Li Guanghui's dismissal. Li Guanghui later learned that Yin Xiaohong had reported this to the manager and told Sun Jingang. Additionally, because Sun Jingang had pursued Yin Xiaohong but was rejected, Sun Jingang was quite angry. On the night of September 9, the three planned to go to Yangtai Mountain Villa to take Yin Xiaohong down the mountain for two days; he believed Sun Jingang might have sexual relations with Yin Xiaohong. At about 11:00 p.m., after drinking, the three went up the mountain together. At approximately 2:00 a.m. the next day, Sun Jingang kicked open the restaurant door, and the three knocked on the door of Yin Xiaohong's dormitory twice, but were refused both times. Sun Jingang then reached through the window to open the dormitory door, and the three entered. Sun Jingang told Yin Xiaohong to go down the mountain; when she refused, he slapped her twice. He heard the sound of a bottle falling in the dormitory. When he entered, he saw Wu Jinyan holding a fruit knife, and Li Guanghui, standing at the door, was throwing a bottle inside. The bottle did not go far, and Li Guanghui collapsed. After Li Guanghui collapsed, when he entered the room, he heard Wu Jinyan say, "You bully me, so I stabbed you with the knife." He did not see how Wu Jinyan stabbed Sun Jingang or Li Guanghui. The dormitory courtyard had a three-story building; a male cook lived on the third floor, the second floor had guest rooms with no one staying, and the first floor contained only this female staff dormitory. There was no one around, so no one would have heard the shouting and beating in the female staff dormitory.

3. Testimony of witness Yin Xiaohong, mainly stating: At about 8:00 p.m. on September 9, 2003, Sun Jingang called her and asked why she had spoken ill of him, demanding that she come down the mountain. After she refused, Sun Jingang said, "Don't push me. If you don't come down, I'll bring some men up and level Yangtai Mountain Villa," and similar things. At about 1:30 a.m. the next day, she heard the sound of the wooden courtyard door being pushed down. Then Sun Jingang and others knocked on the dormitory door twice, demanding that she open the door, but she refused. Sun Jingang, Li Guanghui, and another unfamiliar man then forcibly opened the door and entered the dormitory. Sun Jingang pulled back her blanket, grabbed her pajamas and pulled them down, breaking the hook of her pajama strap on her left shoulder along with the strap of her bra underneath, and slapped her across the face. At that moment, Wu Jinyan got out of bed, came from behind, and grabbed Sun Jingang to stop him. Sun Jingang turned and punched Wu Jinyan in the upper body, then grabbed the front of Wu Jinyan's pajamas and pulled, completely exposing Wu Jinyan's chest. She took the opportunity to quickly adjust her own pajamas. When she looked up again, she saw Wu Jinyan holding a fruit knife and slashing wildly at Sun Jingang. Sun Jingang dodged, and the sleeve on his left arm was cut by the knife, leaving a gash. He then ran toward the dormitory door. At that moment, Li Guanghui, holding a large iron padlock, hurled it at Wu Jinyan. After throwing the large iron padlock at Wu Jinyan, Li Guanghui turned to leave the dormitory but did not make it out and collapsed on the ground; she saw blood seeping from under his body.

4. Testimony of witness Shi Shuangrong, mainly stating: She, Yin Xiaohong, and Wu Jinyan were all waitresses at the restaurant and lived in the same dormitory. At about 2:00 a.m. on September 10, 2003, Sun Jingang knocked on the dormitory door and called for Yin Xiaohong to open the door, but Yin Xiaohong refused. At about 4:00 a.m., Sun Jingang, Li Guanghui, and Zhang Jinqiang reached through the dormitory window to open the door and entered. Sun Jingang went directly to Yin Xiaohong's bed, exchanged a few words, and then a fight broke out. Wu Jinyan got up and helped Yin Xiaohong fight Sun Jingang. At that moment, Li Guanghui picked up a large lock from the table and hurled it in the direction of Yin Xiaohong's bed. As soon as Li Guanghui threw the lock, he collapsed on the floor in front of Wu Jinyan. Wu Jinyan's pajamas were torn, all the front buttons were missing, and she stood in the middle of the dormitory holding a knife, in a daze.

5. Testimony of witness Quan Ting, mainly stating: On the evening of September 9, 2003, he was dining with some friends at the restaurant. At approximately 2:00 a.m. the next day, he saw three men knocking on the hotel door, asking for a female waitress. Because it was too late, he did not let the three men enter the hotel. At about 4:00 a.m., two men knocked on his room door; one of them had an injured arm and asked him to help take the other man to the hospital. He followed them to the female staff dormitory and found a man lying face down inside the door, head outward, with a large pool of blood on the floor; his breath and pulse were gone. He then took the man to the hospital with his friends and reported the incident to the police.

6. Testimony of witness Zhang Jianxun, mainly stating: He was a doctor at the medical unit of Unit 66489 of the People's Liberation Army. The medical unit was located in a remote area with no nearby hospitals, and local residents often came there for emergency treatment. At 4:25 a.m. on September 10, 2003, when Li Guanghui was brought to the medical unit, his heartbeat and pulse had already stopped, his pupils were dilated, and he had a stab wound on his left chest, consistent with clinical signs of death.

7. Autopsy report, mainly stating: Li Guanghui died of acute hemorrhagic shock caused by a sharp instrument (single-edged blade) piercing the heart. The black-handled fruit knife recovered from the scene could have caused the said injury.

8. Scene investigation report, mainly stating: The scene was the restaurant's female staff dormitory. The dormitory door was a single door opening inward to the north. On the ground north of the door, there were spot-like bloodstains. On the ground inside the room south of the door, there were patchy and spot-like bloodstains. Under the east wall of the room was a single bed, under the south wall was a wooden cabinet, under the west wall was a single bed, and under the north wall was a wooden cabinet.

9. Public security organ's alarm record, mainly stating: The alarm was made by Quan Ting, who called "110" at 4:11 a.m. on September 10, 2003.

10. Medical certificate, mainly stating: Sun Jingang had sharp instrument wounds on his left upper arm and left elbow.

11. Physical evidence: one iron padlock, 11 cm long, 6.5 cm wide, weighing 550 grams; one fruit knife with a blade length of 14.5 cm and a width of 2 cm.

12. A written document from the public security organ describing the arrest process, mainly stating: Wu Jinyan was apprehended by the public security authorities at 4:30 a.m. on September 10, 2003.

After cross-examination, the defendant Wu Jinyan had no objections to the above evidence. Wu Jinyan's defense counsel argued that Sun Jingang and Zhang Jinqiang, as two principal witnesses in this case, did not mention in their testimonies the key facts of how Li Guanghui used the large iron padlock to strike Wu Jinyan and how Wu Jinyan stabbed Li Guanghui. Instead, their testimonies included statements about how the three conspired to carry out unlawful acts at the female staff dormitory. The prosecutor's omission of this exculpatory testimony when reading the witnesses' statements was improper, and it should have been read in its entirety. Upon the defense counsel's suggestion, the prosecutor supplemented the evidence by presenting the portions of the testimonies of witnesses Sun Jingang and Zhang Jinqiang concerning their pre-incident conspiracy.

The Beijing Haidian District People's Court held:

Sun Jingang and Zhang Jinqiang are two principal witnesses in this case. Although their testimonies did not address how Li Guanghui used the iron padlock to strike the defendant Wu Jinyan, or how Wu Jinyan stabbed Li Guanghui, these facts were confirmed by Wu Jinyan's own statement and the testimonies of witnesses Yin Xiaohong and Shi Shuangrong. In Zhang Jinqiang's testimony, he mentioned that Li Guanghui stood at the door and threw a bottle into the room. A comprehensive review of Wu Jinyan's statement, the testimonies of Yin Xiaohong, Shi Shuangrong, and Zhang Jinqiang, and the scene investigation findings, leads to the conclusion that the "bottle" referred to by Zhang Jinqiang was in fact the iron padlock that Li Guanghui picked up from the table in the dormitory and was about to throw at Wu Jinyan. Additionally, although the prosecutor initially did not read out the details of the conspiracy among Sun Jingang, Zhang Jinqiang, and Li Guanghui before going up the mountain, this evidence was supplemented upon the defense counsel's suggestion, and therefore this fact should also be established.

The female staff dormitory in question was a place provided by the employer for female waitresses to rest and handle private matters. Entering the female staff dormitory without permission seriously infringes upon the legitimate rights of the occupants. In this case, Sun Jingang, Li Guanghui, and Zhang Jinqiang had previously conspired to take Yin Xiaohong down the mountain and detain her for two days, intending to "leave a mark" on her. Thereafter, the three went up the mountain and demanded entry into the female staff dormitory; when refused, they broke down the door and entered with unlawful intent.

Article 20(1) of the Criminal Law provides: "An act that is carried out to stop an unlawful infringement, in order to protect the State, the public interest, or the person, property, or other rights of oneself or another person from an ongoing unlawful infringement, and that causes harm to the unlawful infringer, constitutes justifiable defense and shall not bear criminal liability." Paragraph (3) provides: "Where a defensive act taken against ongoing violent crimes such as assault, murder, robbery, rape, kidnapping, or other violent crimes that seriously endanger personal safety causes injury or death to the unlawful infringer, it does not constitute excessive defense and shall not bear criminal liability."

After Sun Jingang and the others forcibly entered the female staff dormitory at approximately 3:00 a.m., they beat the female waitresses and tore at their clothing. Such conduct was sufficient to cause the three female waitresses in the dormitory, who were isolated and without assistance, to experience extreme psychological fear. Facing a serious infringement on the personal safety of herself and others, the defendant Wu Jinyan, grabbing a fruit knife within reach, pointed it at Sun Jingang, cutting his left upper arm and repelling him. At this time, the defender was the infringed-upon Wu Jinyan, the object of defense was Sun Jingang, who had entered the dormitory and was committing the infringement, and the time of defense was when the infringement was ongoing. This defensive act was clearly justifiable defense.

After Sun Jingang was repelled by the defendant Wu Jinyan's knife, Li Guanghui picked up an iron padlock, 11 cm long, 6.5 cm wide, and weighing 550 grams, intending to strike Wu Jinyan. Li Guanghui's conduct should not be interpreted as an attempt to stop the struggle between Sun Jingang and Wu Jinyan. Although Li Guanghui did not physically grab or beat Yin Xiaohong or Wu Jinyan after entering the female staff dormitory, he had entered the dormitory in the dead of night, together with Sun Jingang, pursuant to their pre-concerted plan. Li Guanghui was neither a bystander nor a mediator, but a joint participant in the unlawful infringement. Li Guanghui's act of raising the iron padlock to strike Wu Jinyan constituted a continued attack on Wu Jinyan. Faced with the threat of Li Guanghui's continued assault, Wu Jinyan stabbed Li Guanghui with the knife. Her purpose was plainly to avoid suffering a more serious violent attack. Whether viewed from the perspective of the defender, the purpose of defense, the object of defense, or the timing of defense, Wu Jinyan's defensive act was justified. Since Wu Jinyan was defending against a violent act that seriously endangered personal safety, although it caused Li Guanghui's death, it fell within the scope permitted by Article 20(3) of the Criminal Law, did not constitute excessive defense, and she bore no criminal liability according to law.

The defendant Wu Jinyan, in the dead of night and in a place where she was isolated and helpless, suffered beatings and humiliation, placing her body and mind under extreme disgrace and fear. At that moment, Li Guanghui raised an iron padlock and hurled it at her. Faced with such circumstances, Wu Jinyan's use of the knife in her hand for defense did not exceed the necessary limit. The opinion that Wu Jinyan should have carefully chosen other methods to stop or avoid the ongoing unlawful infringement fails to give due consideration to the objective factors such as the time and place of the infringement and the specific circumstances of the offensive conduct, and is therefore not adopted.

In summary, the arguments and defenses of the defendant, Wu Jinyan, and her defense counsel that the conduct constituted justifiable defense and that she should bear no criminal liability or civil compensation are in accordance with the law and should be adopted. The facts alleged in the indictment that Wu Jinyan caused the death of Li Guanghui by stabbing him are clear and the evidence is reliable and sufficient, but the charge as alleged cannot be established. Accordingly, the Haidian District People's Court of Beijing, pursuant to Article 162, item (2) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 128 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, on July 29, 2004, rendered the following judgment:

1. The defendant, Wu Jinyan, is not guilty.
2. The defendant, Wu Jinyan, shall not bear civil compensation liability.

After the judgment was pronounced at first instance, the Haidian District People's Procuratorate of Beijing filed a protest, and the plaintiffs in the incidental civil action, Li Quanyou and Zhang Dehua, also appealed on the grounds that the main facts as found in the original judgment were unclear and that Wu Jinyan's conduct did not constitute justifiable defense, requesting that the judgment be amended to find Wu Jinyan criminally and civilly liable. During the proceedings at second instance, the First Branch of the Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate determined that the protest filed by the Haidian District People's Procuratorate was improper and decided to withdraw the protest.

Upon trial, the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court found that: The facts of this case are clear and the evidence is conclusive. The criminal and incidental civil judgment rendered by the court of first instance, based on the facts and evidence of the case, declaring Wu Jinyan not guilty and that she bears no civil compensation liability, applied the law correctly, the trial procedures were lawful, and the judgment should be sustained. The decision of the First Branch of the Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate to withdraw the protest should be accepted. Accordingly, the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court, pursuant to Article 189, item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 241 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on September 16, 2004, rendered the following ruling:

1. The appeals of Li Quanyou and Zhang Dehua are dismissed, and the judgment on the civil component of the original trial is sustained.
2. The withdrawal of the protest by the First Branch of the Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate is permitted.
